prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: lime green. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture, print dots and small pieces of tape.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Every surface is matte printed paper reflecting only the room light: cutouts, chips, ribbons and ground all read as photographed paper, with the same flat finish edge to edge. No glow, neon, bloom or halo anywhere.
7. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
8. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip, large, with safe margins. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: lime green.
Subjects: a rising paper bar; paper coins.
Opens on the taped key, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The previous chip slides off as the taped key straightens into a rising paper bar; coins stack along it and settle at the top.
Ends holding on the rising bar.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "+293% YOY".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "+293% YOY". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "Revenue grew two hundred and ninety-three percent to two million dollars.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a modern editorial paper collage style, photographed as a flat lay under soft room light with a consistent light source from the upper left casting small, soft shadows beneath each layer. The scene opens on <Picture 1>, featuring a magenta paper ground with a halftone black-and-white cutout of a key held by pieces of translucent matte tape. Immediately, the magenta ground is covered by a single, unbroken block of lime green matte paper that slides in rapidly from the left. Simultaneously, the previous headline chips and the key cutout slide off-screen to the left. As the lime green ground settles, a cream-colored paper chip with a rough torn edge lands firmly in the upper third of the frame; printed on it in extra-bold black sans-serif typography is the text "+293% YOY", which remains clean, legible, and stable. In the lower two-thirds of the frame, the taped key from the first frame transforms as it straightens and extends upward, becoming a vertical, rising paper bar. This bar is a black-and-white halftone cutout with rough white torn-paper edges. As the bar rises, several blank, unmarked halftone paper coins—circular cutouts with no symbols or lettering—rapidly slide in from the sides, stacking one by one along the bar and settling in a neat pile at the very top. The camera is a Static Shot throughout. The motion features a fast entry with a slight overshoot before stabilizing. The video ends by holding on the final composition of the rising bar, the stacked coins, and the "+293% YOY" headline. A male narrator (S1), with a warm, clear, and natural timbre and a brisk but unhurried speaking rate, says: <d>[English] Revenue grew two hundred and ninety-three percent to two million dollars.</d>

overall_soundscape: The audio is dominated by a clean voiceover. Beneath the narration, distinct diegetic sounds of paper include crisp, tactile paper-slaps as the chips and coins land, and the subtle, sticky peeling and sticking sound of matte tape.
